/-!
# Erdős–Rado sunflower conjecture

This file is a Wikipedia-facing entry point for the formalization in
`FormalConjectures.ErdosProblems.«20»`.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunflower_(mathematics))
-/

reformulations.difference: This imported theorem uses a minimum threshold for families of exactly n-element sets with cardinality at least the threshold, a strict exponential bound with natural-number constants, and all natural petal counts. Wikipedia uses a strict family-size threshold, allows member sets of size at most n, and states the conjecture for petal counts at least three.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: On the theorem's domain n > 0, padding each smaller set with private dummy elements preserves family cardinality and pairwise intersections, so the uniform and bounded-size formulations are equivalent. For positive petal counts, Lean's minimum threshold is Wikipedia's threshold plus one. Enlarging and rounding up the exponential base absorbs this shift and the strict inequality. The additional petal counts 0, 1, and 2 have thresholds 0, 1, and 2, respectively, so bases 1, 2, and 3 suffice. Choosing one constant for each petal count is equivalent to the existential function c. The classical sunflower lemma ensures the threshold set is nonempty. Positive n forces member sets to be finite; positive candidate thresholds force qualifying families to be finite, and infinite families are handled by taking finite subfamilies.

sources_consulted: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunflower_(mathematics) — definitions, threshold conventions, sunflower lemma, main conjecture, and weak variant/status.

Alweiss, Lovett, Wu, and Zhang, Improved bounds for the sunflower lemma, arXiv:1908.08483 — introduction, uniformity reduction, and subsequent-work remarks; LaTeX source read at https://arxiv.org/e-print/1908.08483.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HowieHwong/lean-erdos-proofs/b8b641ba2d00dc4d1fe205a078a4159372672459/Erdos/P20.lean — definitions and cited Erdős–Rado bound proof.
FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/20.lean and FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Combinatorics/SetFamily/Sunflower.lean — local checkout at the specified commit.
Mathlib/Data/Set/Card.lean, Mathlib/Logic/Pairwise.lean, and Mathlib/Order/Lattice/Nat.lean — local definitions of natural cardinality, pairwise relations, and natural-number infima.
review.notes: The specified 27-line Wikipedia file contains only imports and a module docstring: it declares no mathematical objects, answer slots, or status attributes itself. The reformulation above concerns its explicitly designated imported entry point, ErdosProblems/20.lean.
